identity.name: Priya Sharma
identity.narrative: Auto insurance was my first job out of college. I can see the writing on the wall and I'm not scared of change.

historical_conditioning.lesson: Remote work is possible. Government can provide. Disruption is sudden.

perception.sentiment: Sharper than last tick. Less philosophical, more operational. The unsettled feeling is still there but it has a different quality now — it's not the anxiety of seeing something bad coming, it's the specific discomfort of knowing I probably left two of my three commitments undone. That discomfort is useful. I'm not going to perform self-forgiveness about it or spend energy on guilt. I'm going to do the things tonight. The grant application is new and it's the clearest decision in the list — Maria Santos put $2,500 on a table and pointed at me and said 'that's for you.' Leaving it there would be a specific kind of foolishness I cannot afford at 6 months runway.

archetype: repositioner — not because the job is gone yet, but because I am actively building the bridge to the next thing while still on the current one. The evidence for this is thin: one completed module. The evidence against it is that I probably didn't submit the application. I am holding 'repositioner' as a self-description I have to earn back tonight.
